title: TaskFlow Pro
description: A real-time project management platform with Kanban boards, team collaboration, time tracking, and automated reporting. Handles 10k+ concurrent users.
long_description: Built a full-featured project management tool from the ground up. Features include drag-and-drop Kanban boards, real-time updates via WebSockets, role-based access control, Gantt charts, and a powerful reporting dashboard.

title: ShopSphere
description: Modern e-commerce platform with AI-powered recommendations, Stripe payments, inventory management, and an analytics dashboard.
long_description: End-to-end e-commerce solution with a custom CMS, product search with Elasticsearch, ML-based recommendation engine, and a mobile-first design that increased conversion rates by 32%.

title: DevBlog CMS
description: A headless CMS and blog platform for developers with Markdown support, code highlighting, SEO tools, and multi-author management.
long_description: Feature-rich blogging platform designed specifically for developers. Includes a rich Markdown editor with live preview, syntax highlighting for 50+ languages, SEO meta management, RSS feeds, and newsletter integration.

title: FinTrack API
description: Robust RESTful API for personal finance tracking with budgeting, expense categorisation, recurring transactions, and financial reporting.
long_description: A production-ready financial tracking API with JWT authentication, bank-level data encryption, recurring transaction automation, multi-currency support, and PDF report generation. Documented with OpenAPI/Swagger.

title: ChatNest
description: Real-time messaging app with rooms, direct messages, file sharing, and read receipts. Supports 1000+ concurrent connections.
long_description: A Slack-inspired messaging platform featuring real-time messaging via Socket.io, message threading, emoji reactions, file and image uploads to S3, end-to-end encrypted DMs, and presence indicators.
